draft.title: Review Halcyon Staffing invoice against contract and approved timecards

rules.text: Every labor line's hourly bill rate must equal the contract rate card rate for that line's role.

citations.quote: Every rate on it has to match our contract.

rules.text: No employee may appear on more than one labor line for the same week ending date.

citations.quote: And nobody should be billed twice for the same week.

rules.text: For each labor line, billed hours must be less than or equal to the approved_hours shown on that employee's timecard for the billed week.

citations.quote: Then I check each person's hours against their timecard.
Billed hours can't go over that.

rules.text: If any check fails, recommend disputing the invoice and requesting a credit; otherwise the invoice passes review.

citations.quote: If anything is off, I dispute it and ask for a credit.

rules.text: Sign in to the Halcyon Staffing client portal, open the invoices list, and open the invoice under review by its invoice number.

citations.quote: Sign in

rules.text: For each person billed on the invoice, click that line's "View timecard" link to open the employee's timecard for the billed week, read the approved_hours field, then return to the invoice before opening the next person's timecard.

citations.quote: Then I check each person's hours against their timecard.
View timecard
View timecard

open_questions: Where are the contract rates found? The reviewer says every rate must match the contract but never opens it, and no per-role rates were stated.
How should duplicate billing for the same week be detected? It was stated as a rule but not demonstrated.
How is a dispute filed and a credit requested? This was not demonstrated.
Does a small difference (e.g. rounding) count as "off", or is any difference a failure?
Which non-labor charges are allowed and what are their caps? None were stated in the recording.
